notes: This is a later-stage analytical compression, not the primitive source of IW speech.
Early IW roots are embodied sound-events. The later alphabet groups repeated mouth-actions after generations of use.
Each base family has two common realizations, but not every contrast is light/deep. Some are position, routing, duration, release, or breath-phase contrasts.
motto: The body speaks first. The alphabet is what remains after generations of mouths, hands, and stones agree on a pattern.

consonant_families.name: lip-teeth friction
consonant_families.operation: filtered friction through lip and teeth
consonant_families.gesture: lower lip brushes the teeth while the hand filters outward

consonant_families.name: lip closure/release
consonant_families.operation: closed lips opening into pressure release
consonant_families.conditioning: surface pop versus resonant body release
consonant_families.gesture: closed fist opens from the mouth line

consonant_families.name: ridge friction
consonant_families.gesture: two fingers hover at the throat while breath narrows

consonant_families.name: tongue-teeth threshold
consonant_families.operation: tongue held at the teeth as a boundary sound
consonant_families.gesture: two fingers hold at the lip edge before turning away
consonant_families.brief_meaning: threshold, taboo edge, named limit, tested safety

consonant_families.name: tongue-up closure
consonant_families.operation: tongue lifts and releases from the upper mouth
consonant_families.conditioning: quick surface tap versus resonant release
consonant_families.gesture: two fingers tap forward and release
consonant_families.brief_meaning: strike, command, work rhythm, disciplined release

consonant_families.name: back-mouth closure
consonant_families.operation: back of the mouth closes and opens
consonant_families.conditioning: hard back closure versus grounded throat closure
consonant_families.gesture: cupped hand closes inward near the ribs

consonant_families.name: nasal/internal binding
consonant_families.operation: sound closes into the mouth and nose
consonant_families.conditioning: lip-nasal internal hold versus tongue-nasal forward hold
consonant_families.gesture: hand closes over the chest, then releases through the nose

consonant_families.name: liquid routing
consonant_families.operation: flow routed around or along the tongue
consonant_families.gesture: finger traces a bending path around an obstacle

consonant_families.name: release-friction scrape
consonant_families.conditioning: short released scrape versus longer spread hush
consonant_families.gesture: flat hand scrapes forward, then folds downward
consonant_families.brief_meaning: scrape, cooling cover, released danger, ritual hush

consonant_families.name: breath gate
consonant_families.operation: breath onset, release, or venting without full oral closure
consonant_families.gesture: open palm lowers as breath leaves the body

vowel_families.gesture: two fingers narrow toward a point
one finger draws a thin upward line
hand rounds into a small chamber
